name: DeleteCrossAccount

parameters.help_en: The UID of the account to back up
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role of the account to back up. This parameter is required when you configure cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role
parameters.help_zh: 基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份时，配置需备份账号的RAM角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT**: Cross-account backup is configured by assuming a RAM role.

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT\_BY\_RD**: Cross-account backup is configured based on a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT**：基于RAM角色扮演配置跨账号备份
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT_BY_RD**：基于资源目录配置跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type
